subject: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review — FinTechCo (pool sizing, autoscale, isolation)
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechco.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.g@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review — FinTechCo (pool sizing, autoscale, isolation)

Hi Raj / Elena,

Thanks again for the call last week — great context on the latency SLAs and burst patterns. As discussed, we'd like to run a technical deep-dive focused on Dedicated GPU capacity for your production rollout: pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under tail traffic, tenant isolation strategies, and failure/fallback plans.

Proposed agenda (60 min):
- 5m quick intros and goals
- 15m FinTechCo workload profile + current constraints
- 25m architecture review: pool sizing math, autoscale policies, isolation (VM vs GPU slice), KV cache and warm-start considerations
- 10m next steps / rollouts / follow-ups

Can you confirm which of these slots works for your infra and security stakeholders?
- Wed, Aug 25: 09:00–10:00 PT (noon–1:00 ET)
- Thu, Aug 26: 16:00–17:00 CET (07:00–08:00 PT)

Attachments: capacity-ask-template.xlsx (please fill in the top section prior to the session), redwood-dedicated-deck-v2.pdf (brief). I can also circulate a runbook draft if helpful.

If those times don't work, propose two that do and we'll try to align. Goal is to have folks who own cluster sizing, SRE/ops, and security on the call.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Grace O'Connor | Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechco.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review — FinTechCo (pool sizing, autoscale, isolation)

Thanks Grace — we want to move quickly on this. Thu Aug 26 (16:00 CET) looks better for our EU infra lead (Elena) and our security lead (cc'd). Wed 9am PT conflicts with our deployment window.

Attendees from our side: me (Raj), Elena Garcia (infra lead), and Maya Singh (security) — I added ops-eng@fintechco.com for calendar. I’ll ask Maya to pre-read the capacity-ask template, but happy if you can give a 5–10 minute primer during the call on the fields you're most interested in.

One note: can we include expected failure scenarios in the agenda (node preemption, zone loss) — that will determine our fallback acceptance criteria.

– Raj
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Garcia <elena.g@fintechco.com>, ops-eng@fintechco.com
Date: 2027-08-18T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity architecture review — FinTechCo (pool sizing, autoscale, isolation)

Appreciate the quick reply, Raj — Thu Aug 26 at 16:00 CET is fine on our side. Moving forward with that slot.

Quick clarifications and asks before the meeting:
1) Failure scenarios: yes — we'll cover node preemption, zone loss, and cross-pool fallback (we'll bring recommended RTO/RPO targets for each).
2) Prework: please upload a completed capacity-ask-template.xlsx (top worksheet) 24 hours before the call. If you can't, a short CSV with peak sustained tokens/sec and 95/99th latency samples will suffice.
3) Internal attendees: Marissa (capacity/product lead) will cover pool sizing heuristics; Karthik (runtime engineering) will demo how autoscale policies interact with continuous batching and KV cache warm-starts.
4) Runbook: I attached pool-runbook-draft.md — it has a proposed escalation ladder, warm-start checklist, and a short playbook for failover to lighter quantized variants. We'll treat it as draft and collect feedback.

Proposed final calendar slot:
- Thu, 2027-08-26 16:00–17:00 CET / 07:00–08:00 PT (Zoom link to follow)

If any stakeholder cannot make it, we can optionally record and do a 20–30 minute follow-up with only infra/security.

Thanks — we'll send an official calendar invite with an agenda and the Zoom link by EOD.

Best,
Grace
